readerCopy.body: The urge to blow up the situation may be strongest where you have felt stuck in the same pattern before. Uranus square the South Node can make an old routine, role, or expectation suddenly intolerable. You may want to quit, cut contact, cancel the plan, or change everything at once simply because you cannot stand repeating it again. The need for change may be valid. Separate the part that needs freedom from the part that is reacting to the history. A different future does not require the messiest possible exit.
